definitions: A force tending to pull or stretch something to an extreme degree.
An injury to a part of the body, such as a muscle, caused by overstretching or overuse.
A particular breed, variety, or kind of animal or plant.
A particular quality or tendency that is part of a person's character or a situation.
A piece of music or a tune.
examples: The strain on the bridge was immense.
He pulled a muscle and suffered a strain.
A new strain of flu has emerged.
There was a strain of sadness in her voice.
